sections.title: Proseminar in Research & Analysis
sections.description: This course is designed to provide students with the skills, information, and resources that are necessary to develop a research proposal. This course will also examine strategies for completing proposals and dissertations. A variety of research designs and approaches to educational research will be explored. Through this course, students will become both informed consumers of research and effective designers of research. Prereqisite: Permission needed from deartment.
